title: Quantifying Cognitive Bias Induction in LLM-Generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying the sentiment (positive, negative, or neutral) of both the original source text and the LLM-generated summary using an LLM-as-a-judge, then calculating the fraction of instances where the summary's framing shifts from the original.

Dividing the source context into three equal segments (beginning, middle, end) and measuring the cosine similarity between text embeddings of the generated summary and each segment to detect disproportionate focus on initial information.

Quantifying model hallucinations by testing the LLM's strict accuracy in fact-checking pairs of real and falsified (counterfactual) news items, specifically comparing performance on events before and after the model's knowledge cutoff date.
